summary: Enforced strict fail-closed startup validation for authentication and session cookies in production. Any attempt to configure COOKIE_SECURE=false, insecure SameSite values (such as 'none' or invalid strings), or insecure cookie flags in production now immediately halts application startup with a fatal RuntimeError. Eliminated warning-only overrides in auth session handling, ensuring cookies always carry secure=True, httponly=True, and samesite in {'lax', 'strict'}. Validated startup refusal at both Settings model validation and create_app factory levels.

files_modified.changes: Added strict production validation rules in _validate_production_security to check cookie_secure and cookie_samesite, raising RuntimeError if COOKIE_SECURE is disabled or SameSite is not 'lax' or 'strict'. Updated cookie_secure_effective property.
Added fail-closed defense-in-depth security checks in create_app() to refuse startup if cookie_secure is False or cookie_samesite is insecure when running in production.

Replaced warning-only log message with fatal RuntimeError in _set_auth_cookies and _cookie_params when insecure cookie parameters are attempted in production. Added httponly=True on _clear_auth_cookies.

Created comprehensive 22-test suite covering production settings validation failure, env var handling, SameSite validation, positive valid production configurations, create_app startup enforcement, domain cookie emission flags, and permissive development mode.

invariants_verified.fail_closed_production_cookies: In production (ENVIRONMENT=production), configuring COOKIE_SECURE=false, '0', 'off', or 'no' raises a fatal RuntimeError on startup.
invariants_verified.samesite_production_restriction: In production, COOKIE_SAMESITE must be 'lax' or 'strict'; 'none' or invalid values fail closed with RuntimeError.
invariants_verified.secure_emission_contract: All auth cookies (_set_auth_cookies) emit Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes in production with zero warning-only plaintext fallback.
invariants_verified.factory_defense_in_depth: create_app() explicitly checks production cookie security posture and halts application startup on violation.
invariants_verified.dev_permissiveness: Development environments remain permissive (allowing cookie_secure=False) to support local HTTP development workflows without breaking.
